description: Top trader gainers/losers. Returns the ranked list of wallets by realized/unrealized PnL over a time window (yesterday/today/1W/30d/90d). Example: birdeye_gainers_losers({ type: "1W", sort_by: "PnL", chain: "solana", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Birdeye API key (get one at birdeye.so; limited free tier).

chain.description: Blockchain to query (sent as the x-chain header). Defaults to "solana".

limit.description: Number of traders to return (1–50, default 20).

type.description: Time window for PnL ranking: "yesterday", "today", "1W", "30d", or "90d". Defaults to "1W".

name: birdeye_gainers_losers
title: Birdeye Gainers Losers
